cues.caption: Welcome back, champ!
cues.text: Hey champ, welcome back! Ready for something really fun today?

cues.caption: Last time: chatbots predict · keep info private
cues.text: Last time, we met chatbots. They predict replies from patterns, they have no feelings, and we never share private info with them.

cues.caption: Chapter 4 · Faces, Filters, and Fun
cues.text: Today is chapter four. Faces, filters, and fun!

cues.caption: How does the phone know where to put them?
cues.text: You've probably seen a photo filter. Puppy ears, funny glasses, a shiny crown! But how does the phone know where to put them? Hmm. Let's find out.

cues.caption: Meet Kabir, on a birthday video call
cues.text: Meet Kabir. It's his cousin Meera's birthday, and the whole family is on a video call.

cues.caption: Pop! Puppy ears and a tongue!
cues.text: Kabir taps a button, and pop! Puppy ears appear on his head, with a long pink tongue. Everyone laughs!

cues.caption: He turns his head. The ears follow!
cues.text: Then Kabir turns his head left, and right. And the ears follow him, staying right on top of his head!

cues.caption: How does the phone know? A tiny artist?
cues.text: How does the phone know where Kabir's head is? Is there a tiny artist inside, painting really fast? What do you think?

cues.caption: No artist, no magic. A program finding patterns!
cues.text: No tiny artist, and no magic. Just a clever computer program, finding patterns in the picture. Let's see how it works.

cues.caption: AR filter: adds fun things on top of the picture
cues.text: This kind of camera fun has a name. An A R filter. It's a camera effect that adds fun things, like ears or glasses, on top of the real picture.

cues.caption: Real picture below · fun drawings on top
cues.text: Think of a clear sticker sheet, laid over a photo. The real picture of your face stays underneath. The fun drawings sit on top.

cues.caption: Filter = find the face + draw on top
cues.text: So a filter does two big jobs. Find the face, then draw on top.

cues.caption: Step 1: find the face in the picture
cues.text: Step one. Find the face. The program looks at the camera picture, and searches for the pattern of a face. Two eyes, a nose, and a mouth.

cues.caption: Step 2: mark points · eyes · nose · mouth · head
cues.text: Step two. Mark the face points. These are spots like the corners of your eyes, the tip of your nose, your mouth, and the top of your head.

cues.caption: Step 3: ears on head points, glasses on eyes
cues.text: Step three. Draw on top. Puppy ears go on the head points. Glasses go on the eye points. Ta-da!

cues.caption: No face found? Nowhere to put the ears!
cues.text: And the order matters. If the filter can't find a face first, it has nowhere to put the ears!

cues.caption: It finds face points again, many times a second
cues.text: So why do the ears follow Kabir? Because the filter doesn't find his face just once. It finds his face points again, and again, many times every second.

cues.caption: Points move → ears move. Like a flipbook!
cues.text: When Kabir turns his head, the points move. And the filter draws the ears again, on the new points. It's like a flipbook. It happens so fast, it looks smooth.

cues.caption: Uh-oh! Glasses on Meera's forehead. Why?
cues.text: But filters can get confused. That night, Meera tries a glasses filter in a dim room. And the glasses land on her forehead! Why do you think that happened?

cues.caption: Poor light → wrong eye points → wrong spot
cues.text: In poor light, the filter marked her eye points in the wrong place. Wrong points, so the glasses went to the wrong spot.

cues.caption: Half the face hidden? Not enough points!
cues.text: Then Kabir's little sister, Pari, covers half her face with her hand. Poof! Her bunny ears disappear. The filter can't find enough face points.

cues.caption: Not magic: hidden patterns cause mistakes
cues.text: Remember, a filter is not magic, and it's not alive. It just finds patterns. When the pattern is hidden, or unclear, it makes mistakes.

cues.caption: Put the filter steps in order!
cues.text: Quick game! These filter steps got mixed up. A, draw glasses on the eye points. B, find the face. C, mark points, like eyes and nose. What's the right order? Pause, and think.

cues.caption: B → C → A: Find · Mark · Draw
cues.text: B, then C, then A! Find the face. Mark the points. Then draw on top. You've got it!

cues.caption: The camera still takes your face picture
cues.text: Now, here's something important. Filters are fun. But while you play, the camera is still taking a picture of your face.

cues.caption: A face picture is personal, even with a filter
cues.text: And a face picture is personal. It shows who you are, even with puppy ears and a funny tongue on top.

cues.caption: Beauty filters aren't real. You're great as you are!
cues.text: Some filters even change how skin and faces look, to make them look perfect. But that's not how real faces look. Your real face is great, just as it is!

cues.caption: Post Meera's filtered photo without asking?
cues.text: After the call, Kabir saves a funny picture of Meera, with bunny ears. He wants to post it. The filter hides who she is, right? So can he just post it? Hmm. Think.

cues.caption: Still her face. Always ask first!
cues.text: No! It's still Meera's face. So Kabir asks, Meera, can I share this? That's good filter manners.

cues.caption: Ask first · Be kind · Grown-up OK for new apps
cues.text: Here are three filter manners. Ask before posting anyone's photo, even your cousin's. Never use filters to make fun of people. And ask a grown-up before you try a new filter app.

cues.caption: Your turn: practice check
cues.text: Okay champ, it's practice check time, just like the quiz.

cues.caption: What must a filter find before adding ears?
cues.text: What does a filter need to find, before it can add puppy ears? Pause the video, and write your answer on paper.

cues.caption: Your face and its points, like the head top!
cues.text: It needs to find your face, and mark its points, like the top of your head. Then it knows exactly where to put the ears. Super thinking!

cues.caption: Filter = find the face + draw on top
cues.text: Let's remember. A filter finds your face, then draws on top.

cues.caption: It needs face points first
cues.text: It needs face points first, and it finds them again and again.

cues.caption: The camera still takes your face picture
cues.text: Even with a filter, the camera still takes your face picture.

cues.caption: Ask before posting someone's photo
cues.text: And always ask before posting someone's photo.

cues.caption: Chapter 4 done!
cues.text: Chapter four, done! Now you know the secret behind filters, champ.

cues.caption: Next: Quiz · Tap Finish
cues.text: Now let's see what you remember. Tap Finish, and try the quiz. You've got this!
